To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) there are no reliable framing or conditional format effects; (2) there is no evidence for positive correlation between height and weight; (3) there is evidence for positive correlation of weight and body fat; (4) there is evidence of negative correlation of height with body fat; and (5) all findings are consistent with the principle of aggregation.

the covariation structure of the height-weight-body fat problem is not affected by conditional framing, and the covariation judgments of the height-weight problem are affected by conditional framing.
